parameters.query:
WITH payload AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS value
), saved_document AS (
  INSERT INTO kb_documents (source_key, title, source_type, source_url, object_key, status, version, checksum, published_at, metadata, tenant_id, visibility, access_groups)
  SELECT
    value->>'source_key', value->>'title', value->>'source_type',
    COALESCE(value->>'source_url', ''), COALESCE(value->>'object_key', ''),
    'published', (value->>'version')::integer, value->>'checksum', NOW(),
    COALESCE(value->'metadata', '{}'::jsonb), COALESCE(value->>'tenant_id', 'default'),
    COALESCE(value->>'visibility', 'restricted'),
    ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(value->'access_groups', '[]'::jsonb)))
  FROM payload
  ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, source_key, version) DO UPDATE SET
    title = EXCLUDED.title, source_type = EXCLUDED.source_type, source_url = EXCLUDED.source_url,
    object_key = EXCLUDED.object_key, status = 'published', checksum = EXCLUDED.checksum,
    published_at = NOW(), metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata,
    visibility = EXCLUDED.visibility, access_groups = EXCLUDED.access_groups
  RETURNING id, source_key, version, status, tenant_id
), inserted_chunks AS (
  INSERT INTO kb_chunks (document_id, tenant_id, chunk_key, content, search_terms, page_start, page_end, section, ordinal, decision_steps, project_types, geography, embedding, metadata)
  SELECT
    d.id, d.tenant_id,
    COALESCE(chunk->>'chunk_key', encode(digest(d.tenant_id || ':' || d.source_key || ':' || d.version || ':' || (chunk->>'ordinal') || ':' || (chunk->>'content'), 'sha256'), 'hex')),
    chunk->>'content', COALESCE(chunk->>'search_terms', ''), NULLIF(chunk->>'page_start', '')::integer,
    NULLIF(chunk->>'page_end', '')::integer, COALESCE(chunk->>'section', ''), (chunk->>'ordinal')::integer,
    ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(chunk->'decision_steps', '[]'::jsonb))),
    ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(chunk->'project_types', '[]'::jsonb))),
    ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(chunk->'geography', '[]'::jsonb))),
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(chunk->'embedding') = 'array' THEN (chunk->>'embedding')::vector(768) ELSE NULL END,
    COALESCE(chunk->'metadata', '{}'::jsonb)
  FROM saved_document d
  CROSS JOIN payload
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(payload.value->'chunks') AS chunk
  ON CONFLICT (document_id, ordinal) DO UPDATE SET
    tenant_id = EXCLUDED.tenant_id, chunk_key = EXCLUDED.chunk_key, content = EXCLUDED.content, search_terms = EXCLUDED.search_terms,
    page_start = EXCLUDED.page_start, page_end = EXCLUDED.page_end, section = EXCLUDED.section,
    decision_steps = EXCLUDED.decision_steps, project_types = EXCLUDED.project_types,
    geography = EXCLUDED.geography, embedding = EXCLUDED.embedding, metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata
  RETURNING id, ordinal
), removed_stale_chunks AS (
  DELETE FROM kb_chunks
  WHERE document_id = (SELECT id FROM saved_document)
    AND ordinal NOT IN (SELECT ordinal FROM inserted_chunks)
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT d.id AS document_id, d.source_key, d.version, d.status, (SELECT count(*) FROM inserted_chunks)::integer AS chunk_count
FROM saved_document d;
